card.name: Linking words in radiation cancer-risk text
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'an' or 'with' in the stock radiation-risk sentence 'cumulative radiation exposure is associated with an increased risk of cancer'. Also fires in text about long-term effects in atomic-bomb or cancer survivors.

modes.label: Radiation risk sentence
modes.description: The word 'an' (or 'with') inside the sentence linking long-term cumulative radiation exposure to increased cancer risk.
modes.example: Long-term cumulative radiation exposure is associated with<< an>> increased risk of cancer.

modes.label: Long-term effects in survivors
modes.description: Words in descriptions of long-term follow-up or studies of survivors of radiation or cancer.
modes.example: Studies of Japanese Atomic-bomb Surv<<ivors>> In 1947 President

card.plain: It marks the linking words in the standard warning that long-term radiation exposure goes with a higher cancer risk, and in related survivor-study text.
